name: Implicit Maze
description: A guild race whose route included an intersection on the Promenade.

description_citations.text: "Transguild Promenade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Guildpact is destroyed, the Implicit Maze manifests across Ravnica.
timeline.quote: manifested after the Guildpact was destroyed

citation.text: "Dragon's Maze", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek discovers the maze on Niv-Mizzet's instruction using Jace's notes.
timeline.quote: it was discovered by Ral Zarek

citation.text: "Dragon's Maze", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the appointed time the champions meet at the Transguild Promenade and race through the maze.
timeline.quote: At an appointed time, the champions meet at the Transguild Promenade and embark on a race through the twists and turns of the maze.

citation.text: "Dragon's Maze", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace begins to piece together the greater mystery of the Implicit Maze, setting off a race to unlock its secrets.
timeline.quote: Jace begins to piece together the greater mystery of the Implicit Maze .

citation.text: "Gatecrash", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav attempts to exploit the Implicit Maze to make the maze-runners kill each other; Jace merges the champions' minds and is made the Living Guildpact, thwarting him.
timeline.quote: His plan to destroy the rival guilds and seize power for the Dimir was thwarted

citation.text: "Lazav", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Izzet discover Azor I's contingency plan; the power of a new Guildpact is bestowed on Jace, who becomes the Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: That power was eventually bestowed upon Jace Beleren

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "The Guildpact reinstated". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa completes the Implicit Maze but Lazav causes mayhem until Jace links the maze-runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and making him the Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: this triggered the Supreme Verdict , which restored the Guildpact 's magic and empowered Jace as Ravnica's first Living Guildpact .

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Maze-runner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The guilds gather at the Promenade intersection for the start of the Implicit Maze; Ral blasts Melek and announces himself as the Izzet runner.
timeline.quote: Ral quickly blasted him with lightning, dispersing his energy.

citation.text: "Transguild Promenade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
